posts.cooked:
I backed the latest Kickstarter and will be getting a copy of Shattered Timelines & Vengeance plus all the extra goodies and I had a quick question.

I wondered if anyone knew whether these expansions were going to include card dividers (for the heroes, environments, villians) like the Enhanced Edition had. I really hope that the creators thought of this and included them. It would be pretty sad to have the nice dividers for half of the stuff and not to have similar ones for the new chars, villians, environments.

 

Thanks!
